name: questions.architecture.baseline
description: Baseline intake questions for software architecture style, documentation, and evolution strategy.

questions.text: Which best describes the current architectural style?
questions.rationale: Style drives nearly every other assessment axis — team topology, data boundaries, deployment model.

questions.text: What are the main bounded contexts or top-level services?
questions.rationale: Lists the units of change; frames the evidence needed for domain boundaries and integration risks.

questions.text: Is there a documented architecture decision record (ADR) practice?
options: Yes, active ADRs in version control
questions.rationale: ADR maturity is a strong proxy for design discipline and change governance.

questions.text: What is the dominant language and framework combination?
questions.rationale: Skill-set and hiring pool map directly to language choice; influences team proposals later.

questions.text: What are the highest-traffic or most business-critical flows end-to-end?
questions.rationale: Focus area for performance, reliability, and observability assessment depth.

questions.text: Are there known architectural debt items the team is already tracking?
questions.rationale: Pre-known debt lets us confirm/deepen rather than re-discover — saves engagement hours.
